map.独立双样本 t 检验计算器：输入两组独立样本数据，计算 t 值与 p 值，判断两: Independent two-sample t-test calculator: enter two independent samples, compute the t value and p value, and judge whether the two population means differ significantly; used in experiments and comparative studies.
map.t = (x̄₁ − x̄₂) / √(s_p²(1/n₁ + 1/n₂))；s: t = (x_mean1 - x_mean2) / sqrt(s_p^2 (1/n_1 + 1/n_2)); s_p^2 is the pooled variance
map.独立双样本 t 统计量用两组均值之差除以合并标准误，衡量两组总体均值是否有显著差: The independent two-sample t statistic divides the difference between the two group means by the pooled standard error, measuring whether the two population means differ significantly. The pooled variance s_p^2 is a weighted average by the two sample sizes, with degrees of freedom df = n_1 + n_2 - 2. The larger |t| is, the more likely the null hypothesis that the two means are equal is rejected.
map.两独立组均值差异：t=(m1−m2)/√(sp²(1/n1+1/n2))。: Difference between two independent group means: t = (m1 - m2) / sqrt(s_p^2 (1/n1 + 1/n2)).
map.df=n1+n2−2，判断差异是否显著。: df = n1 + n2 - 2, used to judge whether the difference is significant.
map.方差齐性假设（不齐用 Welch）。: Homogeneity of variance assumption (use Welch if unequal).
